summary: Denali Therapeutics Inc. filed an 8-K detailing an asset purchase agreement to sell its Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher (PRV) to an unnamed buyer for $195 million in cash, payable at closing. The PRV was awarded upon FDA approval of AVLAYA (tividenofusp alfa) for Hunter syndrome in March 2026. The agreement includes customary representations, warranties, and indemnification, with closing subject to HSR antitrust review. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Proceeds will support Denali's pipeline advancement. Risk-arb focus: watch for HSR clearance and any regulatory challenges to the PRV transfer.
